cat << 'PYEOF' > /tmp/build_seq.py
target = "(((((((((((((((((...(.(..((.(((.(((.((....).))).)))).).)..))..))))))).(((((..(.(..((.(((.(((((.(((.((((.((....).)))).))))).))).)))).).)..))..)((....))..))))(((((((((...))))).(((((...)))))(.(....).).)))).)))).((((.((((...(((((((...))))))).(((((...)))))))))(((((((...))))))).(((((...)))))))))((((..((....))(..((..(..(.(.(((.((((.((....).)))).)))).)..)..).))..))))).))))))"
print("len", len(target))
# build pairing map
stack=[]
pair={}
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pair[j]=i
        pair[i]=j
# count unpaired
unpaired=[i for i in range(len(target)) if i not in pair]
print("pairs", len(pair)//2, "unpaired", len(unpaired))

import random
random.seed(42)
# Build sequence: choose GC for stems preferentially (strong), AU some.
seq=['A']*len(target)
# For each pair, decide G-C or A-U. Use mostly GC for stability, some AU.
pair_list=[]
seen=set()
for i in range(len(target)):
    if i in pair and i not in seen:
        j=pair[i]
        pair_list.append((i,j))
        seen.add(i); seen.add(j)

# assign pair types: cycle to keep GC content reasonable
# pattern: alternate GC and AU but bias GC
types=['GC','CG','AU','UA','GC','CG']
for idx,(i,j) in enumerate(pair_list):
    t=types[idx%len(types)]
    if t=='GC':
        seq[i]='G'; seq[j]='C'
    elif t=='CG':
        seq[i]='C'; seq[j]='G'
    elif t=='AU':
        seq[i]='A'; seq[j]='U'
    elif t=='UA':
        seq[i]='U'; seq[j]='A'

# fill unpaired (loops) with stable patterns
# For hairpin loops of length 3-4, use GNRA-like: GAAA tetraloop, GAA triloop
# Just fill unpaired with A mostly, but make loops start with G where beneficial
for i in unpaired:
    seq[i]='A'

# Now set tetraloop/hairpin loops to GNRA: positions of loops
# From analysis, loops at various positions. Let's just make 4-nt loops = GAAA, 3-nt = GAA
# hairpin loops: closing_pair@[37,42] loop@[38,41] len4
loop_specs = [
    (38,41,4),(106,109,4),(144,147,4),(165,167,3),(179,181,3),(190,193,4),
    (227,229,3),(243,245,3),(262,264,3),(278,280,3),(298,301,4),(329,332,4)
]
for (lo,hi,ln) in loop_specs:
    if ln==4:
        # GAAA
        seq[lo]='G'; seq[lo+1]='A'; seq[lo+2]='A'; seq[lo+3]='A'
    else:
        seq[lo]='G'; seq[lo+1]='A'; seq[lo+2]='A'

result=''.join(seq)
print(result)
print("LEN", len(result))
